# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_VWAP_RECLAIM

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When ATR contracts sharply indicating low volatility, and price simultaneously breaks above the prior 20-bar high while reclaiming VWAP (price > VWAP), a momentum continuation bias exists. This setup captures the transition from compression to expansion with a defined intraday trend trigger.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** On a 5‑minute bar, if ATR(5) < 0.6 × ATR(20) AND the bar’s close > highest high of the prior 20 bars AND VWAP (intraday) crosses below price (i.e., price > VWAP) on the same bar, enter long at the bar’s close.  
**Exit:** Initial stop = low of the breakout bar. TP1 = 2 × risk (R) from entry. After TP1, trail the remaining position with a premium‑based trailing stop of 1.5% (i.e., stop moves up as premium increases, never down).  
**Regime filters:** Only consider bars between 10:00–13:30 ET, avoid the first 30 minutes after open, and require VIX < 20 to ensure low‑volatility environment.
